core: Long- and very-long-chain fatty acid elongation
qualifier: including essential omega-3/omega-6 fatty acid metabolism
name: Very-long-chain fatty acid elongation and essential PUFA metabolism
rationale: All members concern elongation/synthesis of long and very-long-chain fatty acyl chains, including linoleic and alpha-linolenic acid metabolism, which distinguishes the theme from ether-lipid/wax (C1) and peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation neighbours (C2-C4).

qualifier: with nematode and chitin responses
name: Defensin antimicrobial defense with nematode and chitin responses
rationale: Members share mucosal antimicrobial effector activity (defensins, cytolysis, agglutination, membrane disruption), and the response to nematodes and chitin metabolism distinguish it from the antibacterial/antifungal and metal-sequestration neighbours.

core: Pathogen subversion of host cell defenses
qualifier: by bacterial toxins and intracellular pathogens
name: Bacterial toxin and intracellular-pathogen subversion of host defenses
rationale: Members describe pathogens manipulating host cells (Mtb blocking NO, autophagy, apoptosis, membrane repair and phagolysosome fusion; anthrax and diphtheria toxin uptake; Leishmania damping), whereas neighbours centre on bacterial entry, phagosome acidification or anti-inflammatory cytokine signaling.

qualifier: downstream of TNFR1, via linear polyubiquitination
name: TNFR1-driven NF-kappaB regulation and linear polyubiquitination
rationale: All members regulate NF-kappaB/transcription factor activity, with TNFR1 signaling and linear ubiquitination setting it apart from deubiquitination/SUMO neighbours and TLR- or non-canonical NIK-driven NF-kappaB neighbours.

core: SLC organic ion transport of drugs
qualifier: organic anions and cations, drug ADME
name: Organic anion and cation transporter-mediated drug disposition
rationale: Members are SLC22/SLCO-mediated organic anion and cation transport and the ADME of drugs these carriers handle, while neighbours emphasise bilirubin/hyperbilirubinemia, glucuronidation and blood-brain-barrier xenobiotic transport.

qualifier: with Polycomb silencing and SASP
name: Stress-induced senescence with Polycomb silencing and SASP
rationale: Members cover oxidative/stress-induced premature senescence, the secretory phenotype and BMI1/Polycomb repression of cell-cycle loci, distinguishing it from oncogene-induced, replicative and p53/UV-arrest neighbours.

qualifier: with tubulin glutamylation and microtubule severing
name: Chaperonin tubulin/actin folding and tubulin glutamylation
rationale: Members cover CCT/TRiC and prefoldin folding of tubulin, actin and G-beta plus post-chaperonin tubulin processing, and the tubulin C-terminal (de)glutamylation and microtubule severing set it apart from general ER/refolding chaperone and acetylation neighbours.

qualifier: blood-group antigens and tyrosine-sulfated selectin ligands
name: Fucosylated blood-group glycans and sulfated selectin ligands
rationale: Members concern GDP-fucose supply, ABO/Lewis fucosylated oligosaccharides and protein tyrosine sulfation that together build selectin ligands for leukocyte rolling and stem-cell homing, unlike the CDG nucleotide-sugar transporter and O/N-glycan elongation neighbours.

qualifier: SLC12 family, potassium channels and inherited defects
name: Cation-chloride cotransporters, potassium channels and inherited defects
rationale: Members are SLC12 cation-coupled chloride cotransporters with their Bartter, Gitelman and ACCPN defects, potassium channels and anion homeostasis, distinct from renal sodium/osmotic regulation, paracellular magnesium and SLC26 anion-exchange neighbours.

qualifier: with AP-1 immediate-early transcriptional response
name: TAK1-JNK/p38 signaling and AP-1 immediate-early response
rationale: Members regulate TAK1-driven JNK and p38 cascades and the AP-1/NR4A immediate-early gene programme induced by growth factors and TNF, distinguishing it from ERK negative-feedback, UV-response and alpha-kinase-1 neighbours.

qualifier: histamine signaling, TRP channels and itch
name: Histamine signaling in gastric secretion, gut motility and itch
rationale: Members link histamine metabolism, receptors and response to gastric acid secretion, GI smooth-muscle contraction and itch via TRP channels, while neighbours centre on serotonin, tachykinin, muscarinic or urinary smooth-muscle control.

qualifier: with inherited MutS/MutL defects
name: DNA mismatch repair and its inherited MutS/MutL defects
rationale: Nearly all members are MutSalpha/MutSbeta-directed mismatch repair or defects in MSH2, MSH3, MSH6, MLH1 and PMS2 (with repeat maintenance and MSI-linked TCF7L2 mutants), distinguishing it from TGF-beta cancer mutants, somatic hypermutation, BER and break-repair neighbours.

qualifier: with deubiquitinases and misfolded-protein quality control
name: Ubiquitin-proteasome degradation and misfolded-protein quality control
rationale: Members span ubiquitin chain synthesis and editing, DUB families, proteasome assembly, ERAD, aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated autophagy and ribosome-associated quality control, a broader degradation-and-quality-control scope than the chaperonin-folding, neddylation and stalled-ribosome/stress-granule neighbours.

qualifier: and amyloid precursor protein turnover
name: Amyloid fibril formation and amyloid precursor protein regulation
rationale: Members concern amyloid fibril and tangle assembly and regulation of APP synthesis and catabolism (with related amide metabolism and microglial activation), whereas neighbours centre on amyloid-beta clearance and glial activation.

qualifier: calcium-triggered exocytosis and its presynaptic modulation
name: Presynaptic calcium-triggered neurotransmitter release and its modulation
rationale: Members cover synaptic vesicle docking, priming, SNARE assembly and calcium-dependent exocytosis for multiple transmitters plus presynaptic G-protein and kainate modulation, unlike the vesicle-recycling and postsynaptic AMPA/kainate receptor neighbours.

qualifier: MITF-M regulation and melanosome biogenesis
name: MITF-driven melanocyte pigmentation and melanosome biogenesis
rationale: Members are MITF-M target programmes, melanin synthesis, melanosome and related-organelle (dense granule) biogenesis, pigment granule transport and eye pigmentation, distinguishing it from keratinocyte/epidermal, UV-response and intestinal epithelial neighbours.

qualifier: with synoviocyte proliferation and matrix metalloproteinase control
name: Monocyte activation and endothelial adhesion with synoviocyte proliferation
rationale: Members regulate monocyte activation, aggregation and leukocyte adhesion to endothelium, adhesion-molecule and CXCL2 production, extravasation, and synovial hyaluronan/MMP/synoviocyte responses, the latter separating it from monocyte chemotaxis, integrin diapedesis and inflammatory-cytokine neighbours.

qualifier: lipid droplets, adipocytes and glycerolipid synthesis
name: Adipocyte triglyceride storage, lipolysis and lipid droplet dynamics
rationale: Members cover PA/DAG/TAG synthesis, triglyceride lipolysis, lipid droplet formation, fusion and lipophagy and adipogenesis, distinguishing it from phosphatidylcholine synthesis, fatty acid oxidation and LXR-lipogenesis/VLDL neighbours.

core: Sodium and potassium transmembrane transport regulation
qualifier: renal sodium handling and potassium response
name: Regulation of sodium-potassium transport and renal sodium handling
rationale: All members regulate Na+ export/import, K+ import or responses to potassium, with renal sodium transport and potassium sensing distinguishing it from P-type ATPase gradient, paracellular magnesium, SLC12 cotransporter and osmotic-response neighbours.

qualifier: zygotic epigenetic reprogramming and cleavage
name: Maternal-to-zygotic transition with zygotic chromatin reprogramming
rationale: Members cover the maternal-to-zygotic handover (Z-decay of maternal mRNA, maternal protein storage, cleavage) plus pronuclear chromatin/epigenetic programming, separating it from maternal M-decay/deadenylation and germline piRNA/ZGA neighbours.

qualifier: CYP26 catabolism and retinoic acid response
name: Retinoic acid synthesis, CYP26 catabolism and cellular response
rationale: Members concern retinal/retinoic acid synthesis, CYP26-mediated terpenoid catabolism and its defects, and responses to retinoic acid and vitamin A, distinguishing it from retinol transport/visual-cycle, vitamin D and steroidogenic CYP neighbours.

qualifier: exosome-type surveillance plus tRNA maturation
name: Nuclear RNA surveillance, 3'-end trimming and tRNA maturation
rationale: Members cover nuclear 3'-to-5' processing and degradation of snoRNA, snRNA, rRNA, CUTs and aberrant mRNA together with nuclear tRNA processing, unlike cytoplasmic NMD/ribosome-rescue, nucleolar rRNA cleavage and siRNA-focused neighbours.

qualifier: with siRNA and tRNA-fragment biogenesis
name: Nuclear tRNA maturation and small regulatory RNA biogenesis
rationale: Members are tRNA 5'-leader, intron and 3'-end processing, tRNA-derived fragment generation and siRNA biogenesis, distinguishing it from nuclear RNA-decay and mitochondrial RNA/tRNA processing neighbours.

qualifier: nucleotide pool sanitization and nucleoside-analog drug metabolism
name: Nucleotide pool sanitization and nucleoside-analog drug metabolism
rationale: Members cover NUDT hydrolysis and interconversion of (d)NTPs that protect DNA, and the metabolism of nucleoside-analog/thiopurine drugs (abacavir, ribavirin, azathioprine, TPMT methylation), unlike de novo purine synthesis, pyrimidine catabolism, nucleoside transport and ADA/PNP neighbours.

qualifier: modified lipoprotein uptake and foam cell formation
name: Scavenger receptor uptake of modified lipoproteins and foam cells
rationale: Members are class A/B/F/H scavenger receptor uptake, oxidized LDL responses, lipoprotein signaling and transport, phospholipid catabolism and foam cell differentiation, distinguishing it from apoptotic-cell/amyloid clearance and LXR cholesterol-efflux neighbours.
